Excellent Bún Bò of beef
Aug 2025 • Family
It was our first dining experience in Vietnam and we loved it.

This is an extremely small restaurant with a reduced menu that stands out for its beef Bòn, which has earned its fame among locals and therefore now attracts many tourists. For VND 95,000 it is possible to taste its star dish and a soft drink, rising slightly more in price if you opt for the option with extra beef.

Service is fast and very correct. The dining area seems small, but it is very well used because they bring people from several groups together at the same table without problem.

Importantly, it can only be paid in cash.
